title: The Fox Den
lines: Ben and Dad sit on a log.
"A fox has cubs in a den," said Dad.
"Can I see the cubs?" said Ben.
"Yes, but do not run," said Dad.
Ben has a bug net. He taps Dad on the leg.
"Sit. The cubs are not up yet," said Dad.
Ben sits. Ten bugs hop on his net.
Six cubs hop up at the den!
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
